description: This PHP script handles the deletion of an inbound email record in the SuiteCRM application, including validation, retrieving the related bean, clearing folder subscriptions, marking the record as deleted, and redirecting.

classes.name: SugarFolder
classes.description: A class representing a folder in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM application, used here to clear subscription for a specific folder.

methods.name: clearSubscriptionsForFolder
methods.description: Clears all subscriptions associated with a specific folder ID.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a bean record based on its ID.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks a record as deleted in the database.
